title: Raku Workshop
source_quote: Paseo Pottery conducts Raku Workshops on the third Friday of every month!
evidence_sentence: The raku page states monthly workshops occur on the third Friday, where participants fire bisque-fired pieces in metal cans.
evidence_quote: Paseo Pottery conducts Raku Workshops on the third Friday of every month!
summary: Monthly raku firings on the third Friday of each month. Bring bisque-fired pieces (max 19 inches tall) and pay $195 for 150 cubic inches of firing plus one vase; additional firing costs $25 per 50 cubic inches. Ages 18+, max 15 people per workshop.
cost_text: $195 per person; includes 150 cubic inches of raku firing and one 3" vase. Additional firing $25 per 50 cubic inches.
bring: Bisque-fired pottery pieces (max 19 inches tall); glazing can be done in advance or day-of
how_to_join: Register online via the signup link
